howItWorks: Paste or type the text you want to check.
Press Analyze reading level. The tool counts sentences, words and syllables.
Review the Flesch Reading Ease score, grade level and supporting statistics.
examples: A simple children's story usually scores above 80 on Flesch Reading Ease.
Academic papers often land in the 30–50 range and require higher education.
Marketing copy aims for 60–70 so most adults can read it comfortably.

faq.q: What is a good Flesch Reading Ease score?
faq.a: 60–70 is plain English easily understood by 13–15 year olds. Higher is easier; below 30 is difficult.
No. All counting and scoring happens locally in your browser.
A simple vowel-group heuristic is used. It is approximate but good enough for readability estimates.
